title: A New Short Film Joins My Chemical Romance's World
summary: Artist Lauren Tsai has made a new short film with the band My Chemical Romance. The film is called Prelude to The End. It continues the story of Astrid, a character from Tsai's dream world, The Dying World. Tsai first shared that world in a short film last year. As a kid, she made animated fan videos for the band's songs, so working with them now feels like a full circle. The film uses the first song from the band's album The Black Parade, called The End. It comes just after the release of The Black Parade (20th Anniversary). The film will be shown before the band's last shows at the Hollywood Bowl on Oct. 30 and 31. In the story, Astrid goes to a strange boarding school in New England that is full of trash. When school leaders throw her beloved sketchbook down a chute, she follows it into a world of forgotten ideas. There she meets an old friend. Tsai also voices Astrid. Billie Eilish voices Astrid's friend, and Phoebe Bridgers voices her sister.
why_it_matters: It shows that a hobby you start as a kid, like making fan videos, can one day grow into working with the artists you admire.

background_read: A short film is a brief movie that tells one story in much less time than a full-length film.
Musicians sometimes work with artists to build a story world around their songs, with characters and places that carry across films and shows.
Lauren Tsai's dream world follows Astrid, and this new film continues her story as she follows her sketchbook into a world of forgotten ideas.
